message:
The above post accidently was posted before I finished editing it.  The last paragraph should read:

Another point of interest is that she told me that I have a limit of $240.00 that I can spend on calls in a 90 day period, and that even if I keep everything paid up, if I go over $240.00 worth of calls in 90 days, I will get a block put on my line.  She said if I should use up the $240.00 say in the first 30 days, even if I keep it paid up to date, a block will be put on my line AND NOT REMOVED UNTIL THE 91ST DAY FROM WHEN THE CYCLE STARTED. So even if I was paid up to date on that 30th day, I'd have to wait 61 days until my next phone call!  What the heck for?!  If I’m paying for the calls up to date why block the line at some limit THEY picked for my phone usage?  If they are being paid there is no reason for them to decide how often I get to speak to my loved one!  If I’m paid up, there is no excuse for that!
